newsitem.title: UK: N Foods rises on SBC Warburg upgrade.
newsitem.headline: N Foods rises on SBC Warburg upgrade.

text.p: Shares in Northern Foods Plc rose 7-1/2p to 220-1/2p on Wednesday after brokerage house SBC Warburg raised profit forecasts and upgraded its trading advice, dealers said.
Warburg lifted its current year pre-tax estimates to 143 million stg from 135 million and for next year to 157.5 million from 143 milllion and lifted its view to "buy" from "add".
The change was due to currency considerations with sterling strength working in Northern Foods' favour as the company imports a lot of milk, dealers said.
Dairy group Unigate Plc rose 20p to 534p in sympathy.
